name: Clean Calm
description: The clean channel at calm, the gain past its middle: clean and bright, breaking up only when played hard.

name: Clean Rage Crunch
description: The clean channel at rage: the gain of a crunch amp, and the top lifted before it.

name: Fierce Rhythm
description: The high channel at fierce, the depth held back: the lows cut before the gain, for tight palm mutes on a low-tuned guitar.

name: High Calm
description: The high channel at calm with the gain and every tone knob at noon: thick and dark, the lows kept, saturated from a quarter of the gain.

name: Insane Chug
description: The insane channel at fierce with the gain low: one more stage and the lows cut before it, for fast, muted chugs.

name: Rage Lead
description: The high channel at rage, the gain past its middle and the middle up: the most gain of the high channel, for long notes.
